whyMatters.en: Pasadena hard-rock band that made two-handed tapping and high-gain precision a guitar-hero standard; Van Halen (1978) is the debut shock.
whyMatters.zh: 帕萨迪纳 hard-rock：把双手 tapping 与高增益精度做成吉他英雄标准；同名首专（1978）是出道冲击。

note.en: Tapping + harmonics showcase; guitar-hero teaching object.
note.zh: Tapping + 泛音展示；吉他英雄教学对象。

note.en: OBX synth riff + hard-rock chorus; MTV mass single.
note.zh: OBX 合成器 riff + hard-rock 副歌；MTV 大众单曲。

note.en: 5150 opener grammar; Hagar melodic range over Eddie keys.
note.zh: 5150 开场语法；Hagar 旋律音域盖在 Eddie 键盘上。

interviewQuotes.text: If I can do it, anybody can.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Eddie Van Halen

interviewQuotes.text: I am not a rock star. I am a rock singer.
interviewQuotes.speaker: David Lee Roth

shortBio.en: Eddie Van Halen–era hard rock; Eruption is the technique showcase; Roth vs Hagar splits the catalog.
shortBio.zh: Eddie Van Halen 时期 hard rock；Eruption 是技术展示；Roth vs Hagar 分裂目录。

body.en:
Formed 1972. Debut (1978, Ted Templeman) put Eddie’s tapping and brown-sound midrange beside Roth’s showman vocal and Anthony’s high harmonies. 1984 adds OBX synth hits. 1985 Roth→Hagar swap opens 5150 multi-platinum chapter.

Eruption remains the instrumental citation; Jump is the mass single; singer-swap is the chronicle structure.
body.zh:
1972 年组建。首专（1978，Ted Templeman）把 Eddie 的 tapping 与棕色中频，配上 Roth 表演人声与 Anthony 高和声。1984 加入 OBX 合成器热单。1985 Roth→Hagar 打开 5150 多白金章节。

Eruption 仍是器乐引用；Jump 是大众单曲；主唱替换是编年史结构。

title.en: Tapping as hard-rock standard, not parlor trick
title.zh: Tapping 当 hard-rock 标准，不是杂耍

body.en:
Van Halen (1978) exports two-handed tapping, pinched harmonics, and high-gain midrange. Templeman keeps songs short; Roth sells carnival frontman energy.

Guitar-hero culture after 1978 cites this debut as the precision upgrade over blues-rock default.
body.zh:
同名首专（1978）输出双手 tapping、捏泛音与高增益中频。Templeman 把歌唱短；Roth 卖马戏团主唱能量。

1978 后的吉他英雄文化把这张首专当作相对蓝调摇滚默认的精度升级。

title.zh: Roth 时期 vs Hagar 时期

body.en:
Peak chronicle silhouette: Roth / Eddie / Alex / Anthony (1978–85). 1985 Hagar joins; 5150–Balance is the radio-metal chapter fans call Van Hagar. 2007+ Roth returns for reunion tours.

Same guitar core; two vocal grammars. Peak flag stays on Roth-era classic.
body.zh:
编年史巅峰剪影：Roth / Eddie / Alex / Anthony（1978–85）。1985 Hagar 加入；5150–Balance 是粉丝称 Van Hagar 的电台金属章节。2007+ Roth 回归重聚巡演。

同一吉他内核；两套人声语法。巅峰旗留在 Roth 经典期。

body.en:
Eddie: Frankenstein guitar, MXR, Marshall mid. Alex: double-bass and ride accents. Roth: splits and spoken asides. Anthony: high stacked choruses that define the early mix.

Chemistry is the product; later casts prove how loud that chemistry was.
body.zh:
Eddie：Frankenstein 吉他、MXR、Marshall 中频。Alex：双底鼓与 ride 点缀。Roth：劈叉与旁白。Anthony：早期混音里的高叠副歌。

化学反应即产品；后来卡司证明那反应有多响。

body.en:
Instrumental between You Really Got Me cover energy and Ain't Talkin' 'Bout Love. Dive bombs, taps, tremolo abuse—cited in every 80s shred school.

Hard-rock single albums rarely put a solo étude this central.
body.zh:
夹在 You Really Got Me 翻唱能量与 Ain't Talkin' 'Bout Love 之间的器乐。俯冲击、tapping、颤臂滥用——80 年代 shred 学派必引。

Hard-rock 单曲专辑很少把独奏练习曲放这么中心。

title.en: Jump: synth riff, still hard rock
title.zh: Jump：合成器 riff，仍是 hard rock

body.en:
OBX hook, Roth chorus, Eddie still solos. MTV and arena both take it. Not a soft-rock exit—keys as another riff voice.

1984 peak single before the singer swap.
body.zh:
OBX 钩子、Roth 副歌、Eddie 仍独奏。MTV 与体育场都接。不是软摇滚出走——键盘当另一把 riff 声部。

主唱替换前的 1984 峰值单曲。

title.zh: 吉他标准 + 主唱替换案例

body.en:
Technique export is permanent. Catalog debate (Roth vs Hagar) is permanent too. Guns N' Roses and 80s LA hard rock inherit the high-gain precision expectation.

Chronicle value: gear method + lineup versioning in one logo.
body.zh:
技术输出是永久的。目录争论（Roth vs Hagar）也是。Guns N' Roses 与 80 年代洛杉矶 hard rock 继承高增益精度预期。

编年史价值：一个 logo 里同时有装备方法与阵容版本化。

note.zh: 首专至 1984；tapping + 表演人峰值。

note.en: Melodic radio hard rock; Van Hagar catalog.
note.zh: 旋律电台 hard rock；Van Hagar 目录。

note.en: Tapping étude that reset guitar-hero expectations.
note.zh: 重置吉他英雄预期的 tapping 练习曲。

note.en: High-gain precision + Roth/Hagar singer-swap as twin chronicle facts.
note.zh: 高增益精度 + Roth/Hagar 主唱替换为双编年史事实。
